title: lagenaria vulgaris f. gourda
intro: Lagenaria vulgaris f. gourda, commonly known as bottle gourd or calabash, is a type of vining plant belonging to the Cucurbitaceae family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and supporting immune function. The therapeutic actions of Lagenaria vulgaris f. gourda are attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as cucurbitacins, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which exhibit antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. Regular consumption of bottle gourd has been linked to improved cardiovascular health, reduced risk of certain cancers, and enhanced overall well-being.
